title: PMR: MoE Routing with Shared Prototypes and Congestion Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2611.19413v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional linear routers in sparse mixture-of-experts models select experts directly from token-expert matching scores, coupling input matching with expert allocation. We propose Prototype-Mediated Routing (PMR), a two-stage router with shared prototypes. PMR first computes each token's distribution over prototypes, then uses it to mix prototype-conditioned expert distributions according to the law of total probability. This formulation models input matching and expert allocation separately, explicitly represents many-to-many associations between prototypes and experts, and provides separate interfaces for context adaptation and load regulation. Within this framework, short-term states summarize preceding tokens to adapt the prototypes, while congestion prices updated from dispatch feedback achieve loss-free load balancing by adjusting the conditional expert distributions. translated_title: PMR：基于共享原型与拥堵定价的混合专家路由
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家模型中的传统线性路由器直接根据词元-专家匹配分数来选择专家，从而将输入匹配与专家分配耦合在一起。我们提出了原型中介路由（Prototype-Mediated Routing, PMR），这是一种具有共享原型的两阶段路由器。PMR首先计算每个词元在原型上的分布，然后依据全概率公式，利用该分布混合以原型为条件的专家分布。这一建模方式将输入匹配与专家分配分开处理，显式地表示了原型与专家之间的多对多关联，并为上下文适应与负载调节提供了相互独立的接口。在该框架中，短期状态通过总结前序词元来适应原型，而基于分发反馈更新的拥堵价格则通过调整条件专家分布来实现无损的负载均衡。我们采用两遍分块近似来加速短期……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出原型中介路由PMR，通过共享原型将输入匹配与专家分配解耦建模，并借助拥堵定价机制实现无损负载均衡。
